title: Erze++
description: The Erze++ mod adds new ruby-themed items to the game, including tools and armor. It also introduces a brand-new dimension and unique ruby-monsters to explore and fight.
body:
English:



📜 Mod Description – Ruby Mod

This mod adds the rare Ruby Ore to Minecraft, allowing you to craft powerful new items, tools, and armor.

🔹 New Items & Materials

- Ruby: The core item of the mod, dropped from Ruby Ore

- Ruby Ingot: Refined crafting material

![Ruby Ingot smithing recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bae2d63bcdd26c6df54ca822509f314e9d1e91a7.png)

![Ruby Ingot alternative smithing recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9939a1838a8f2aaaee36271df0a8925d8ba10bfa.png)

- Ruby Apple & Ruby Steak: Special food with strong effects

![Ruby Steak smoking recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/37100ce4dc989a44ecf31f53cc1d6946c3ad926e.png)

![Ruby Apple crafting recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/95bb07c5fc8540194ce05107f3f7c0fa8a0c70bb.png)

🔹 Tools & Weapons

- Ruby Sword, Ruby Pickaxe, Ruby Multitool, Ruby Axe, Ruby Hoe, Ruby Shovel
→ faster, stronger, and more durable than vanilla tools

![Ruby Sword crafting recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/860068cc110c1aee46064048c61521904c60f463.png)

![Ruby Pickaxe crafting recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f0c29a1993c050ba2a971e7c585f123be371077a.png)

![Ruby Multitool crafting recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5d2109078aa0d3a09696874e2a1a5caf5f491747.png)

![Ruby Axe crafting recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f462eb4193f62df897373d76f8768c8dfbf35531.png)

![Ruby Hoe crafting recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c86e813649781158650366f96cded2a421b03145.png)

![Ruby Shovel crafting recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b1f73af89ba2b6f1f7018f5b5cbd62691b349e1a.png)

🔹 Armor

- Full Ruby Armor Set (Helmet, Chestplate, Leggings, Boots)
→ grants you powerful protection

![Ruby Helmet crafting recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/de698c4509af3c9d3f258970f7816328c4abc53c.png)

![Ruby Chestplate crafting recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0caf65692bb27abef2fb99eec083cd13bf6163eb.png)

![Ruby Leggins crafting recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/184c7e97695bf5e9abf9a75c2dc1c52fcca2aa8c.png)

![Ruby Shoes crafting recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f6aaed2c1824a57a16e532e7cd32b90ea324e4b2.png)

🔹 Blocks & Structures

- Ruby Ore: Spawns in the Overworld

- Ruby Chest: A custom chest with 36 slots (4×9)

![Ruby Chest crafting recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8062f3933c1458bf32b3547b0437d3826dcd471b.png)

- Ruby House: A generated structure with ruby features

🔹 Recipes & Crafting

- Unique crafting recipes for all ruby items, tools, weapons, and armor

🔹 Dimension & Mobs

- Ruby World: A brand new dimension with its own biome

![Ruby World Ignitor crafting recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6289b3ed71e30f7b09c6309924bebc630cc42bc0.png)

- Ruby Monster: Hostile mobs lurking in the Ruby World

- Ruby fluid: A new fluid that spreads across the world like water or lava

German:



📜 Mod-Beschreibung – Rubin Mod

Dieser Mod fügt das seltene Rubin-Erz in Minecraft hinzu, aus dem du mächtige neue Items, Tools und Rüstungen herstellen kannst.

🔹 Neue Items & Materialien

Rubin: Das Herzstück des Mods, droppt aus Rubin-Erz

Rubinbarren: Weiterverarbeitetes Crafting-Material

Rubinäpfel & Rubinsteak: Besondere Nahrung mit starken Effekten

🔹 Werkzeuge & Waffen

Rubinschwert, Rubinspitzhacke, Rubinmultitool, Rubinaxe, Rubinhacke, Rubinschaufel
→ schneller, stärker und langlebiger als Vanilla-Tools

🔹 Rüstung

Rubinrüstung (Helm, Brustplatte, Hose, Schuhe)
→ gibt dir mächtigen Schutz

🔹 Blöcke & Strukturen

Rubinerz: Spawnt in der Overworld

Rubintruhe: Eine Custom-Kiste mit 36 Slots (4×9)

Rubinhaus: Eine generierte Struktur mit Rubin-Features

🔹 Rezepte & Crafting

Eigene Rezepte für alle Rubin-Items, Waffen, Tools und Rüstungen

🔹 Dimensionen & Monster

Rubinwelt: Eine neue Dimension mit eigenem Biom

Rubinmonster: Gegner, die in der Rubinwelt lauern

Rubin Flüssigkeit: Neue Flüssigkeit, die sich wie Lava/Water ausbreitet
